periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Teardrop-shaped patches oriented at approximately a 45-degree downward angle from the horizontal midline towards the lateral facial edges.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval blobs with a visible height-to-width ratio of approximately 1.5:1 along the primary axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering with the lowest point of the patch shifted significantly below and lateral to its geometric center.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation, with a gap approximately equal to twice the width of a single pinna region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, semicircular convex curvature at the superior boundaries.
